title: Business Central Trivia Recap: October 12–16, 2026
summary: A weekly Business Central Trivia event from October 12-16, 2026 had 21 players answer 250 questions across five days, with 62 percent accuracy. Fixed Assets and Sustainability were the hardest categories, while BC Acronyms and Reporting and Analysis were the easiest.
key_points: 21 players answered 1,420 total questions across five days with 62 percent overall accuracy
Fixed Assets (39%) and Sustainability (42%) were the hardest categories; BC Acronyms (89%) and Reporting and Analysis (80%) were the easiest
Monday had the highest daily accuracy (71%) while Friday had the most answers but lowest accuracy (54%)
Two players completed all 250 questions but no perfect-day awards were achieved this round

quotes.text: 250 questions. Each of the five days had 50 questions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the scope and structure of the weekly trivia event

quotes.text: 62 percent of all answers were correct: 880 answers. That is up from 58 percent last round.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows improved performance week-over-week despite fewer total submissions
